evidence: The full Whanganui Journey is 145 km, from Taumarunui to Pipiriki. It takes an average of 5 days to canoe.
Start at Ngāhuinga (Cherry Grove) Domain, off Cherry Grove Road in Taumarunui.
The Whanganui Journey ends at Pipiriki village.

doubts: This is a canoe trip down the Whanganui River, not a walk; the way is the river, which has no entry in names or links. The main start is the Ngāhuinga (Cherry Grove) Domain in Taumarunui; there is no road-end feature, so the start uses the Taumarunui place entry (T18), as a town start. Pipiriki is the village place (T14). The times 'an average of 5 days' and 'an average of 3 days' are the page's own averages, not a Time heading. The Ohauora Campsite position is inferred from 'Mangapapa to Ohauora Campsite' and 'Ohauora to John Coull Hut', and the Tarepokiore rapid and Tamatea's Cave are passed on the Kirikiriroa loop, so their order is taken from the text. The shorter version starts at Whakahoro (place T23), though Whakahoro Campsite (L4) is also there; the place is used. Ōhura Falls is reached by a short trip up the Ōhura River from the Ohinepane to Whakahoro section, with no leaving point given, so from is null. Puketotara Hut is alternative accommodation reached by a 1 hr 30 min hike and is not on the river, so it is not on the way. Guided and jet boat trips and the 1- and 2-day business trips have no given start or end, so they are not recorded as ways.
